name: Park Lodge Hotel

tagline.en: A family-run hotel and seven self-catering cottages on the coast road outside Spiddal: ideal for families visiting Coláiste Lurgan.
tagline.ga: Óstán teaghlaigh agus seacht dteachín féinfhreastail ar bhóthar an chósta taobh amuigh den Spidéal: iontach do theaghlaigh ag tabhairt cuairte ar Choláiste Lurgan.

address: Park, Spiddal, Co. Galway, H91 ETW1
mapQuery: Park Lodge Hotel, Spiddal, Co. Galway

en: Park Lodge is a family-run hotel on the Galway–Connemara coast road, just outside Spiddal and about 12km from Galway city. All 23 rooms are en-suite.
In the grounds there are seven detached self-catering cottages, with a children’s play area. In July and August cottage guests can use the hotel games room.
It’s a handy, comfortable base for parents visiting students at the Irish colleges in Spiddal, including Coláiste Lurgan.
ga: Is óstán teaghlaigh é Park Lodge ar bhóthar an chósta idir Gaillimh agus Conamara, díreach taobh amuigh den Spidéal agus thart ar 12km ó chathair na Gaillimhe. Tá gach ceann de na 23 seomra en-suite.
Sna tailte tá seacht dteachín féinfhreastail scoite, le háit súgartha do pháistí. In Iúil agus i Lúnasa is féidir le haíonna na dtithíní seomra cluichí an óstáin a úsáid.
Is bonn áisiúil compordach é do thuismitheoirí atá ag tabhairt cuairte ar dhaltaí sna coláistí Gaeilge sa Spidéal, Coláiste Lurgan ina measc.

highlights.ga: Gar do choláistí Gaeilge an Spidéil

desc.en: A detached cottage in the hotel grounds, with a play area nearby. By the week in summer.
desc.ga: Teachín scoite i dtailte an óstáin, le háit súgartha in aice láimhe. In aghaidh na seachtaine sa samhradh.
